body.effect: The data keys are gone; the ciphertext they protected is permanently unreadable. Test images cannot be recovered by anyone, including the sandbox operator.
body.retained: The decision log, the relay hash log and the ledger are retained. They carry hashes, metrics and signatures and no test data; the ledger also names the parties' staff who acted. Art. 19(1) requires them to be kept for at least six months.
